threshold_policy: No automatic relaxation. Failures remain failures; unavailable never passes. A future revision requires explicit review, reason and new version.

performance_budget.scope: one 2–4 second Stage8 body optimization window, one worker; budgets, not measured temporal performance

basis.rationale: 2 GiB Python is about 6x Stage5 tracking RSS; 8 GiB renderer footprint reserves roughly half of the 16 GiB target machine. 120s is an explicit bounded experiment cap, not an ETA.

unavailable_policy.missing_annotations: unavailable; never infer ground truth from the solver being evaluated
unavailable_policy.contacts: foot-bone drift is a proxy; production sole skating remains unavailable without verified contact geometry
unavailable_policy.depth: monocular/world estimates are not metric ground truth
unavailable_policy.lip_sync: requires independently annotated open/closure transition events; video-only scores do not establish audio synchronization
unavailable_policy.holdout: must be a distinct source hash; no thresholds or calibration heuristics tuned on holdout
unavailable_policy.quality_gain: not demonstrated by baseline measurements alone; requires future frozen comparison
